caption: The drawing features a detailed illustration of a circular trivet with a handle, rendered in shades of black and gray on a cream-colored background. The trivet has a round, gear-like outer edge with a textured pattern and eight symmetrical inner spokes forming a radial design, with each section containing a heart-shaped cutout. Three short, sturdy legs support the base. The handle is flat and extends from the edge, decorated with the same textured pattern seen on the edge of the trivet. The composition includes three perspectives: a top-down view of the trivet positioned near the top center, a side elevation view in the middle showing the legs, and a three-quarters perspective view at the bottom right, highlighting its dimensionality. Below the side view is a linear scale marked in inches. The artist’s signature appears in the bottom left corner outside the main drawing area.
title: Pa. German Flat-iron Stand
